sources.entry: Transmute - File converter for images, video, audio, json, excel and more. Supports over 2,000 conversions!. (Source Code) MIT Docker

summary.one_liner: Transmute is a self-hostable file converter listed in awesome-selfhosted that handles images, video, audio, JSON, Excel and other formats, claiming over 2,000 conversions.
summary.what_it_does: The README was not available, so this summary relies on the awesome-selfhosted listing and repository name only. The listing describes Transmute as a file converter for images, video, audio, JSON, Excel and more. It states support for over 2,000 conversions. The listing categorizes it under Miscellaneous and notes MIT license and Docker. Specific conversion pairs, interface type, and setup details could not be verified.
notable: Claims over 2,000 conversions across many file types
caveats: README not available, so setup, features and limits could not be verified
Conversion claims come from the awesome-selfhosted listing, not the project docs
keywords: convert files without uploading to third party
